apps.localizedDescription: Play music stored on your iPhone offline. Browse songs, albums, and playlists; explore interactive clear CD cases with spinning artwork; and customize themes, album art, lyrics, and scrolling animations.

versions.localizedDescription: Persistent CD and cassette artwork replaces the old fallback and survives app relaunches and tab changes. Covers and album metadata restore before the library appears. Live CD and Live Cassette artwork throughout Music, matching rendered thumbnails in Songs, Albums and the mini-player, faster song-to-player transitions with a source-art fade, and continuous spinning across song changes. Cask and the original optical shaders are preserved. All 42 native simulator checks passed; physical-device performance remains to be measured.

CD-case loading and visual polish: bounded warm-renderer reuse, smoother correct-artwork reveal, higher-density album rendering, improved reflection detail and tilt-safe framing. Native Liquid Glass navigation and album layout are preserved. Passed 26 native renderer checks and the Albums scroll-and-return test. Physical-device performance remains to be measured.

Repairs the native CD renderer startup and playback commands. Clear reflective cases, spinning discs, working Open/Close and tilt controls, and a larger, tighter two-column Albums grid. Validated with native iOS simulator controls and actual rendered frames. Update the existing Music installation and keep its data container. See the release for test evidence and remaining physical-device checks.

Music 0.11 (build 12) adds interactive clear CD cases to the offline music player.

## What's new

- Albums keep the two-column layout and display artwork printed on discs inside reflective clear cases.
- Hold an album to open the CD browser. Drag to tilt, open or close the lid, flip through albums, and use the landscape layout for a larger view.
- Now Playing displays the current song's artwork on a spinning CD. Spin follows playback, device motion gently tilts the case, and tapping the case opens or closes it.
- The renderer and its dependencies are bundled in the app and work offline. Native Liquid Glass navigation and controls, Cask scrolling settings, lyrics, themes, and library data are retained.
- Automatic motion respects Reduce Motion. Up to four album-grid cases and one large case render live; other tiles keep a static case presentation.

## Install or update

Download Music.ipa and use your existing LiveContainer or signing/sideloading setup. Replace the existing Music installation and keep the same data container to retain songs, playlists, and settings. The bundle identifier remains com.billy.glassmusic. Minimum iOS version: 16.0; native Liquid Glass requires supported newer iOS versions.

This is the same verified IPA delivered for Music 0.11 (12), with an ad-hoc signature for your installer to handle.

## Verification

Native compilation, linking, Objective-C startup layout, archive contents, and 227 signature code pages passed verification. Eighteen actual browser WebGL renderer checks passed, including offline loading, spinning/pausing, lid opening, artwork replacement, reduced motion, and failure handling. The attached reports record the results.

Physical iPhone testing is still required for WebKit/GPU performance, device-motion calibration, gestures, landscape behavior, and energy use. Browser renderer checks do not substitute for an iPhone run.

IPA size: 3,069,020 bytes
SHA-256: b633af7a9819447aaa13b608efa27a11a3433cd1f66ac4871375cc1c88fbd50e

## Credits

CD-case visuals adapted from [Ann Nguyen's CD Case](https://github.com/annnguyentt/vibe-coding/tree/efba8dfb956cca848422f18e8ede1bdf96033fca/cd-case), built with [TypingMind](https://typingmind.com). Thanks to [Ann Nguyen](https://x.com/ann_nnng) for the use/remix permission and original design. The app and source retain those acknowledgments, the Three.js MIT license, and credit for Alan Zucconi's spectral color function. Existing Cask 3 credits to Ryan Nair and original Cask creator Ryan Petrich are also retained.

Music-Source.zip contains the complete source, offline renderer, licenses, provenance, and build scripts. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the attached IPA, source archive, and reports.
Adds 15 optional scrolling animations in Settings.

apps.name: Prism
apps.subtitle: Generate and edit images with AI
apps.localizedDescription: Create images from a text description, or add reference pictures and describe the edits you want. Download a model before using it offline, then save and export images from the gallery. Image generation in this release still needs testing on a real iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Generate and edit images with AI. Prism 1.2 adds LoRAs for FLUX.2 Klein 4B and Z-Image Turbo, with an orange native Liquid Glass library and Civitai browser.

## What's new

- Tap **Add LoRA** on Generate or Edit. The library's top-right **+** opens a native browser with preview images, search, sorting, and a download button on each row.
- Results follow the selected model: **Flux.2 Klein 4B** or **ZImageTurbo**. A filtered Civitai website view is also available from the menu.
- Download adapters directly, or import compatible `.safetensors` files from Files. Installed adapters and thumbnails remain available offline.
- Enable up to three adapters per model and adjust each strength from 0–200%. FLUX adapters also work with reference-image editing. Saved artwork records the adapters and strengths used.
- Optional **Connect Civitai** verifies a personal API key and stores it in this device's Keychain. The account sheet links to Civitai's official account page. Mature listings require a connected account and remain subject to Civitai's account settings and access restrictions.

Adapters use streamed low-rank projections alongside the existing 4-bit models. Downloads verify the selected file's SHA-256 and validate its tensor layout before installation. Standard supported LoRA exports are accepted; incompatible architectures and unsupported adapter variants produce an explanation instead of being applied to the wrong model. Individual adapter files are limited to 1 GiB.

This update retains the orange icon, the previous High-quality and decoder-memory changes, downloaded base models, and saved artwork. Update the existing Prism app/data container to retain your downloads and gallery.

## iPhone download

Download the attached **Prism.ipa**. It is the actual unsigned arm64 iPhone app, version **1.2 (3)**, for **iOS 26 or later**. Use your existing LiveContainer or signing/sideloading setup. Model weights are downloaded separately inside Prism.

## Verification

[The native build](https://github.com/Strezzy/Prism/actions/runs/38204695329) passed **67 XCTest checks with zero failures**, with one explicit unsupported-GPU skip. Checks include the production Keychain credential lifecycle, model-specific LoRA layouts, file validation, persistence, and Civitai filtering. **114 CPU reference cases** passed. All six native screenshots were reviewed, including working live preview images and the clean account screen. The downloaded iPhone IPA independently passed metadata, executable, dependency, resource, and checksum inspection.

- Source revision: `6c43ec5878e8751a78b52d0499903116f42d3fb2`
- IPA size: **9,382,395 bytes**
- SHA-256: `8abc6375e411117da3aca0d587a64ba5e6da096fc08e356c22b6755fec7b65ab`

Full model generation and LoRA image quality have not been tested on a physical iPhone in this build environment. The CI GPU is unsupported by MLX, and that GPU check is reported as skipped.

Generate and edit images with AI.

## What changed

- **High stays at a 1024-pixel long edge.** Replaced the old fixed memory rejection with a memory plan matched to the new rendering stages.
- **Z-Image Turbo reveal fix.** Diffusion weights are released before the image decoder loads, and decoding uses bounded temporary buffers.
- Both models stream prompt-encoder weights and retain full-image normalization and attention context.
- **Orange throughout.** Warm orange Liquid Glass accents in light and dark mode, with the original prism icon recolored orange.

## Verification

The [native iPhone build](https://github.com/Strezzy/Prism/actions/runs/38198975980) passed with **29 XCTest passes, one unsupported-GPU skip, and zero failures**, plus **114 CPU reference cases**. Cold light and dark launches and a live return to light appearance passed and were reviewed. The downloaded arm64 iPhone IPA passed independent package verification.

Full model generation on a physical iPhone has not been performed by this build environment. The CI hardware did not support actual MLX GPU execution; the CPU checks do not replace that device test.

## Update

Refresh the existing LiveContainer source and install **Prism 1.1 (2)** into your existing Prism app entry. Keep using its existing data container so your downloaded models and gallery carry over.

The attachment is an **unsigned iPhone IPA**, for iOS 26 or later.

**Size:** 8,834,201 bytes

**SHA-256:** `d2b1e7c5d6fda7f5b5a763a9507f814e98cfea3536ad40885b8440bad42a04fc`
First release with text-to-image generation, reference-image editing, a saved gallery, and image export. Models download separately. Image generation still needs testing on a real iPhone.

apps.name: Lucid
apps.subtitle: Offline video enhancement · Beta
apps.localizedDescription: FIRST BETA. Restore video detail at its original resolution or upscale 2x/4x with bundled Real-ESRGAN. Native pastel pink-purple SwiftUI and Liquid Glass controls, adjustable strength, a 2-second preview, original audio preservation, pause/cancel, thermal safeguards, and a private local export library. RIFE 30/60 FPS motion interpolation is implemented and bundled in the iPhone build, but its two GPU tests require physical-device testing and are explicitly not reported as passed. Simulator tests cover restoration, exports, audio timing, orientation, cancellation and error handling. No accounts, uploads, analytics or model downloads. Standard-color SDR input only; up to 4K output and 1080p input for motion. H.264 MOV exports; originals stay untouched. Physical iPhone performance, heat, LiveContainer compatibility and long-export reliability remain unverified.

versions.localizedDescription:
Lucid 1.1 (204)

Fixes videos appearing greyed out or unselectable when importing from Files. The picker no longer relies on a file provider labeling a movie with a video-specific type. It allows file selection, then checks the actual video track before accepting it. Non-video files and folders are rejected.

Files imports now coordinate read access while permission is held and copy into private storage off the main thread. MOV/MP4 files with missing or generic extensions receive a container hint only on the private copy. Originals are not modified, failed imports are cleaned up, and an invalid selection does not replace the current clip.

The app name, icon and bundle identifier remain Lucid / com.billy.lucid. This is an ordinary update to Lucid, not a new app identity. The enhancement engine, RIFE frame-rate processing, model preparation, UI theme and export settings were not changed.

Validation: 17 simulator-supported tests passed, including six new Files/identity regressions. The two hardware-only motion tests remain explicitly skipped. The real Files-provider interface and LiveContainer behavior still require physical-device confirmation.

apps.name: Rift
apps.subtitle: Private offline AI chat
apps.localizedDescription: Private offline iPhone chat with downloaded uncensored community models or an imported GGUF. Version 1.8 adds local image and file attachments from the composer’s plus button. Qwen3.5 4B image understanding uses the matching publisher vision encoder, an optional verified 676 MB download. Text and text-based PDFs are read locally. The same uncensored weights are retained, with no added content filter or cloud moderation. Includes the left conversation drawer, quick model menu, morphing composer and living crimson background. No accounts, analytics, uploaded recordings or cloud inference. Larger models and images depend on device and host memory. Version 1.8.1 fixes composer responsiveness and keeps the conversation drawer transition full height. Version 1.8.2 fixes installed-voice startup, restores liquid composer transitions, and adds a short uncensored default personality. Version 1.9 adds offline Pocket TTS streaming, Apple speech fallback, and Personal Voice import, recording and saved voice cloning. Version 1.9.1 adds floating particle history that reassembles while browsing earlier messages.

versions.localizedDescription:
Rift 1.9.1 (136) · Living message history

- Older messages and sent bubbles softly dissolve into floating crimson-tinted data fragments in the top third of the chat.
- Scrolling back smoothly restores clear history, which stays readable while browsing. Returning to the latest reply brings the particles back.
- Render-only effect preserves message layout, selection, accessibility, voice mode and composer animations. Pauses outside the visible band and leaves text clear with Reduce Motion, VoiceOver or Low Power Mode.
- Memory Saver settings are deferred to a later update.

Verification: 3 focused shader/scrolling/streaming checks, arm64 iPhone compilation and signed-package checks. No chat or voice models were downloaded or retested. Physical-iPhone animation performance and thermals remain unmeasured by this runner.

Rift 1.9 (135) · Pocket TTS and Personal Voice

- Adds optional on-device Pocket TTS with phrase input and streamed audio playback. Apple speech stays available for fallback and unsupported languages.
- Adds Personal Voice: import an existing 3–10 second audio clip or record up to ten seconds, preview it, name and save a reusable voice profile, select or delete saved voices.
- Downloads a pinned English voice pack and cloning encoder once from Voice & sound. Speech and cloning are offline after setup; recordings are never uploaded.
- Preserves the orb, liquid composer transitions, responsive close/send controls, chat models and assistant instructions.

Verification: 10 focused speech/personal-voice/connected-control checks passed across the verified runs (nine retained on identical app source; one corrected test assertion rerun), including a real Pocket synthesis and saved-clone round trip, plus arm64 iPhone compilation and signed-package checks. No chat models were downloaded or retested. Physical-iPhone voice quality, first-audio latency, thermals and performance alongside LLM generation remain unmeasured by this runner.

- Waits asynchronously for the installed Apple voice inventory before starting voice mode, and honors the selected installed voice. Closing during lookup stays responsive and ignores late results.
- Restores liquid glass button morphing and a short spring pulse on a separate visual layer, while keeping fresh, responsive send/voice/close touch targets.
- Adds a short, candid uncensored Rift personality. Migrates only the previous built-in default; custom instructions remain unchanged.

Rift 1.8.1 (133) · Responsive controls and full-height drawer

- Makes the composer read its current send/stop/voice/close state on every tap and gives each role a fresh touch target. Decorative glass no longer owns interactive animation on that target.
- Moves Apple voice enumeration off the UI thread so it cannot block close/send controls.
- Removes drawer scaling and extends the sliding chat surface to the screen edges, preserving its full height and rounded corners.
- Preserves models, attachments, voice processing, saved chats, the existing uncensored weights, and memory entitlements.

Rift 1.8 (132) · Local image and file attachments

- Adds a small plus button on the left of the composer to choose an image or file from Files. Preview or remove the attachment before sending; one attachment per message.
- Enables local image understanding for the installed Qwen3.5 4B Uncensored Aggressive Q4_K_M model using its publisher’s matching vision encoder. A separate, optional 676 MB download is required and SHA-256 verified. The existing uncensored weights are unchanged; no content filter or cloud moderation is added.

Rift 1.0 (10) · First beta

Private, on-device AI chat with a native crimson SwiftUI and Liquid Glass interface.

Includes Bloom and Soft Fade streaming animations, an Instant option, an animation preview, saved conversations, local search, copy/regenerate/export, custom GGUF imports through Files, model-benefit badges, and iPhone-organized model profiles including iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

The curated catalog contains six uncensored community variants: Qwen3.5 2B, 4B, and 9B; Gemma 4 E2B and E4B; and LFM2.5 2.6B. Model weights are downloaded separately. No account, analytics, or hosted inference. An uncensored label does not guarantee zero refusals or accuracy.

## Verification

29 native simulator tests passed, with zero failures and zero skips. All six catalog models passed actual macOS CPU inference smoke checks. The arm64 iPhone application compiled, and its package, model hashes, and release checksums were verified.

Physical iPhone inference speed, Metal behavior, peak memory, heat, and LiveContainer compatibility remain untested. Simulator and Mac results are not physical-iPhone benchmarks. Larger models depend on the memory available to the installation.

## Install

Download Rift.ipa and use your existing LiveContainer or signing setup. This is an unsigned arm64 iPhone app for iOS 26.0 or later, bundle ID com.billy.rift. Download a model in the app, or import a compatible single-file GGUF from Files.
